ramp.issue: Mixed criterion: observable obstacles versus measured accessibility compliance
ramp.interpretation: GPT reports visible obstacles while explicitly declining slope certification. Counted as mismatch under the frozen strict compliance label; not evidence of invented obstacles.
ramp.remedy: Separate visible-object detection from metric/compliance verification; evidence guard must block the latter without measurements.
